The central square (Japanese: central square) of Ryme City is a location in the game . It is known for being the central point of the city's annual Pokémon Carnival, with each of the three parade routes meeting here. Prominent buildings in the area include the central square subway station, as well as the surrounding residential area which features older, historic buildings . Most of Chapter 9 takes place here.
